id: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the four men in moustaches board the train.
facts.why: The plot says four men in similar disguises board the same train at different stations. No opened source says moustaches. The phone menu cue says 'in disguise', which is safe.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when the four men in disguise board the train.

facts.text: Best hero in the building, and it reaches the Command Center inside the hour. Tell them Garber sent you.
facts.why: Garber is a Transit Police lieutenant, so a note from him fits. The film's Transit Authority base is a control center (the set was a replica of the Brooklyn control center), not a command center.
facts.fix: Best hero in the building, and it reaches the Control Center inside the hour. Tell them Garber sent you.

vibe.verdict: Right city, right job and a good Garber, but it misses the film's best jokes and has one line crossed out by a rule.
missing: Mr. Blue, Green, Grey and Brown (the hijackers' colour names)
One million dollars inside one hour (Blue's demand)
The dead man's switch (Garber explains it)
The runaway train into the South Ferry loop (final minutes)
Garber's Gesundheit at the door (final scene)
ideas: Swap 'Flu season special. Get well!' under the Hot Toddy for 'Gesundheit.' and fix the clash with the rule line.
Swap 'Over a million cups poured' for 'One million. One hour.'
Rename the four bakery case items on page one with Mr. Blue, Mr. Green, Mr. Grey and Mr. Brown tags.
Swap the coupon 'No. 123' stamp for a 'Pelham 1 2 3' departure board.
